hypotheses.falsifier: (1) a child run with sys.executable under home_env(scratch) prints Path.home(), os.path.expanduser('~') and cairn.tools.base.address.ROOTS['instance'], and they equal scratch, scratch and scratch/.cairn; (2) home_env(scratch, USERPROFILE=other) gives the child USERPROFILE=other: the caller's extra still applies last; (3) scratch_home_bypass over a testing tree with one proof that does dict(os.environ, HOME=x) and one that calls home_env(x) names exactly the first
